desc:
🥟 Ride a dumpling and steal everyone's land! 🥟

🚩 Close loops to grow your territory!
😈 Cut off players to take them out!
💣 Use Bombs, TNT and the NUKE to grab tons of land!
🎁 Collect 500 dumplings, from Common to MYTHIC!
🥢 Troll your friends with giant chopsticks!

👍 Having fun? Like & ⭐ favorite the game!
